canonical_spec.title: Options and binomial replication
canonical_spec.outcome: Construct replicating portfolios and price options through state-contingent payoffs.

assignments.prerequisite_and_scope_contract: Depend on agreed c05 discounting, forward price/value distinction, funded cash and margin conventions; c03 already proves finite positive-state-price valuation and elementary replication. Teach payoff/rights first, European put–call parity under explicit same maturity, dividends and short-sale rights, one-step signed stock/account replication and q=(R-d)/(u-d), d<R<u and boundary failures, multi-step self-financing tree/hedge and American backward optimal exercise. Derive early-exercise claims under stated rate/dividend assumptions and counterexamples when they change. No Black–Scholes limit or stochastic calculus assumed. Distinguish European terminal payoff from early exercise and safe financing.

assignments.title: Brownian motion and Ito calculus

canonical_spec.title: Brownian motion and Ito calculus
canonical_spec.outcome: Derive stochastic differentials and explain quadratic variation.

assignments.prerequisite_and_scope_contract: Use accepted v02 ordinary calculus/ODE and v03 probability/measure/stochastic foundations plus agreed finite binomial/self-financing c06. Define filtered information, adapted/predictable integrands, Brownian independence/variance/continuity and stochastic integral construction. Prove quadratic variation with stated convergence and distinguish path variation; derive simple-process Itô isometry/martingale and completion within a clearly stated domain; prove a substantive one-dimensional Itô formula under explicit regularity, controlling remainder/cross terms rather than writing (dW)^2=dt as a proof. State any deeper foundational existence/density theorem honestly if not proved. Derive product/cross-variation, explicit GBM exponential solution and log formula, integral W dW, drift versus diffusion, and a carefully scoped SDE existence/uniqueness result or directly verify explicit cases. No general Girsanov assumption or future Black–Scholes formula. Exercises must use taught tools, including proof and research/numerical critique. Numerical Brownian checks are illustrations, not proof. Supply exact expectation/variance or analytical error comparisons plus reproducible original paths/counterexamples.

canonical_spec.title: Black-Scholes and risk-neutral valuation

assignments.prerequisite_and_scope_contract: Depend on c07 contract: Brownian definition, Itô integral/isometry, scalar C1,2 Itô formula under explicit localization/regularity, product rule, explicit dS=mu*Sdt+sigma*SdW and log/GBM solution. Coordinate these assumptions directly with c07 author. Derive self-financing replication PDE with continuous proportional dividend yield and stock total-gain accounting; avoid dropping S*dDelta terms without a financing argument. Construct the constant market-price-of-risk finite-horizon equivalent measure explicitly via exponential normal density and tilted independent increments (prove this special case if general Girsanov not available). Explain discounted total-gain martingale, P versus Q, derive normal call/put formulas from truncated lognormal expectations, verify PDE/payoff/boundaries and uniqueness within declared growth/admissibility class. Treat sigma=0,T=0,S=0 and negative rates carefully; discrete dividends are a different contract. Explain convention/calibration versus empirical truth. No claim of universally exact market hedging.
